answer: Sybil resistance couples identities to real economic exposure: each validator locks collateral in a bonded escrow, and verified correlated equivocation by k coordinated identities incurs pairwise penalties proportional to k(k−1)/2, or O(k²). Detection also applies an escalating exponential multiplier to swarm-wide capital loss, while asymmetric depreciation makes replacement stake costly. A violet thread of matching signed conflicts can expose coordination; a summit of evidence, not identity count alone, justifies slashing.
